warrant: This check grades the numerical quantities named in output-contract.json on the independently materialized official operands. skimage.feature.match_template (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/feature/template.py:33): FFT correlation and the subtraction of squared local sums from local sums of squares amplify cancellation near constant patches; the binary32 absolute correlation bound is therefore separate from the relative bound; skimage.feature.peak_local_max (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/feature/peak.py:118): local gradients, scale-space filtering and peak or descriptor decisions determine the feature measurements; coordinates and associated attributes use one correspondence, and fixed descriptor bits and sample indices remain exact; skimage.util.img_as_float (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/util/dtype.py:479): the stored numerical operands fix the dtype conversion, indexing or array geometry; implementation bookkeeping is excluded and exact integer or boolean results remain exact. The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 0 (skimage.feature.match_template); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The source-linked bounds remain proposals until the human reviews the measured calibration and accepts their scientific scope.
